notes: 1978 special sign districts sheet SSD (whole city at small scale). Frame: a thick bar across the top (lower edge y ~27 at the left to ~43 at the right) and the thick legend bar at the bottom (top edge y ~3775 left to ~3764 right). No rule left or right: the map runs to x ~25 on the left (cut through EL CAMINO DEL MAR / LOBOS AVE) and stops at x ~2950 on the right with blank paper to the page edge, so both sides follow the page edge (rule 5). Top ~2 px under the top bar, bottom ~2 px above the legend bar, carried out to the page edges. Doubt: the map ends at a straight cut at y ~2860 with ~900 px of blank paper down to the legend bar and no rule there; following the rules (the innermost printed rule on that side is the legend bar) that blank paper is inside. Remove (rule 4): the north arrow with its NORTH lettering at the right edge of the bay (x ~2785-2930, y ~1805-1955), a 9-point outline a few px outside the ink, stopping above the '0 FEET 3,000' scale bar, which stays inside. Inside: 'SEE INSET SHEET' cross-references, SAN FRANCISCO BAY lettering, the circled district numbers. Ink under the outline: one small nub on the top bar's lower edge near x 550-600.
